svg.title: KeypointDominantFusionNet loss evaluation and backpropagation
svg.desc: Training diagram showing the trainable KeypointDominantFusionNet, frozen KeyNet response extractor with snowflake icon, keypoint-centric loss terms, validation metrics, and backpropagation route into the trainable network.
svg.text: Frozen KeyNet response extractor supervises a trainable VIS-IR fusion network; only KeypointDominantFusionNet parameters are updated
fused path carries gradient to fused
no gradient to source response computation
backpropagated gradients update trainable fusion parameters
gradient from rf through fused image
optimizer step applies to KeypointDominantFusionNet only
rv, ri, rf -> flatten -> topk indices -> binary masks: vis_mask, ir_mask, f_mask
ret_vis = overlap(vis_mask, f_mask) / topk; ret_ir = overlap(ir_mask, f_mask) / topk
union_recall = overlap(max(vis_mask,ir_mask), f_mask) / union; union_precision = overlap / f_mask
1. Source keypoint maps rv and ri are computed under torch.no_grad(), so they are fixed targets for the current batch.
2. Fused response rf is computed through frozen KeyNet operations, allowing dL/dfused while keeping KeyNet parameters unchanged.
3. Total loss gradients flow through fused, pred_rgb, ir_w, target_y, and attention outputs back into KeypointDominantFusionNet.
4. AMP scaling, gradient clipping, and AdamW update only the trainable fusion model.
